BiblicalUsage: Length is the measure of things, and it belongs to the temple more than anywhere: the house Solomon built for the Lord was threescore cubits in length, and the pattern given for the second temple was measured the same way.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe length is the measure God gave His house: the temple was built to a pattern, and no detail of His dwelling was left to guesswork.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
